rationale.rules-based-checks: Executable specifications and BDD provide deterministic, fail-closed behavioral verification.
rationale.ai-review: Experiments characterize correlated reviewer failures and bound AI review's legitimate residual.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Frames accelerated generation as shifting the bottleneck to costly verification.
rationale.quality-debt: Targets regressions, coupling, layer violations, and architectural drift in AI code.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Specifications and architectural checks bound departures from behavioral and design intent.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes AI-review-first pipelines lacking independent executable specifications.
rationale.framework: Proposes reusable specification-first, deterministic-check, residual-review pipeline architecture.
rationale.design-only: Combined architecture is specified but not implemented as an integrated system.
rationale.agentic: Studies coding agents delivering complete functions for downstream gate-level review.
rationale.steering: Executable specifications also shape generation inputs and constrain produced code.
rationale.risk-quality: Evaluates correctness failures and mitigates regression and architectural-quality harms.
rationale.method-experiment: Contrived planted-bug conditions compare model reviewers against executable BDD checks.
